notification sound.note: Existing string: 來電通知鈴聲 for incoming-call sound; 通知音效 acceptable for non-call sounds but keep 鈴聲 for calls.

share extension.note: Follows Apple zh-TW terminology (app extension → 延伸功能).

swipe.note: Directional forms per existing strings: 向左滑 (swipe left).

tap.note: Existing strings vary (按一下, 按下); Apple zh-TW uses 點一下. 點按 is the neutral convention — converge on it.

toast.note: No established zh-TW term; 快顯訊息 is widely understood for transient confirmations.

passcode.note: Apple zh-TW renders passcode as 密碼 (e.g. Face ID 與密碼), matching the existing string; context distinguishes it from account password.

jailbroken.note: Existing: 越獄後的裝置; for Android 'rooted' use 已 Root/Root 過的裝置.

app logs.note: Not yet translated; 紀錄檔 matches desktop/webapp log terminology (紀錄檔層級).

skin tone.note: Per existing emoji skin strings (預設膚色色調).

server connection.note: Add a server → 新增伺服器 (existing); Switch server → 切換伺服器.
